notes: Original worker class labels only; E23 and all confirmed class-correction sessions excluded.
All outputs are confined to this research directory. Source RGB/depth and SQLite are read-only inputs.
Prior results informed this protocol: retrospective CV must not be described as a new blind experiment.
Hole model: fresh ImageNet initialization plus auxiliary manually annotated LAB images only. The old 16 field images, radar models, pseudo-labels and VLM are excluded.
Pixel/depth calibration and mask class centers are fit to fold TRAIN sessions only. Validation selects checkpoints and CNN rejection thresholds.
Geometry gates are inherited, prespecified engineering choices informed by earlier work, not newly validated limits.
Future prospective evaluation requires a frozen model/protocol and independently recorded human ground truth.
Session is the observed grouping unit; physical-instance and production-lot identity are not established.
